answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking tied to reputation. Each agent must lock real capital to participate, and honest work earns standing that rises slowly like an incoming tide. A sybil attacker has to fund every fake identity separately, so a single deposit cannot echo across thousands of clones; the cost of a flood scales linearly with its size. Misbehavior burns the bond, and an unstaked newcomer flagged violet in the registry simply cannot outvote the capitalized, long-lived majority.
